sentences.en: In the fall of 1999, a new film debuted in just 25 theaters across the United States.

sentences.en: When he crawls inside, he goes through a strange portal

sentences.en: and ends up inside the mind of the actor, John Malkovich.
sentences.zh: 最终进入了演员约翰·马尔科维奇的大脑。

sentences.en: Things only get more wacky from there.

sentences.en: When John Malkovich, the real John Malkovich, inevitably learns about this,

sentences.en: He is determined to go through the portal himself.

sentences.en: The movie is thought-provoking and has long been one of my favorites.

sentences.en: That might be because it is a metaphor for a central idea that we explore on this show.

sentences.en: We like to think that we are in charge of our own minds.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢认为自己掌控着自己的思想。

sentences.en: We decide what we are going to think and what we are going to do.

sentences.en: We decide what to cook for dinner, where to go on vacation, and whom to marry.

sentences.en: But it turns out that there are a vast number of unconscious mental processes

sentences.en: that direct much of how we think and act.

sentences.en: Often, we are unaware of these hidden puppeteers.

sentences.en: They make us say and do things that we haven't consciously chosen ourselves.

sentences.en: Sadly, there's no way to spit these puppeteers out on the side of the New Jersey Turnpike.
